name: Katarina
title: The Sinister Blade

passive.name: Voracity

description.normalized: Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged in the last 3 seconds, her remaining ability cooldowns are reduced by 15 seconds. Katarina slashes at all nearby enemies whenever she picks up a Dagger, dealing 55 (+100% bonus AD +34.5% AP) magic damage.

passive.rawParsedText:
Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged in the last 3 seconds, her remaining ability cooldowns are reduced by 15 seconds.

Katarina slashes at all nearby enemies whenever she picks up a Dagger, dealing 55 (+100% bonus AD +34.5% AP) magic damage.

q.name: Bouncing Blades

description.normalized: Throws a Dagger, dealing 75 / 115 / 155 / 195 (+30% AP) magic damage to the target and 2 nearby enemies. The Dagger then riccochets to the ground behind the initial strike point. The Dagger's time in the air is the same regardless of how many times it bounces.

w.name: Preparation

description.normalized: Tosses a Dagger in the air and hastes Katarina by 50% / 60% / 70% / 80%.

w.rawParsedText: Tosses a Dagger in the air and hastes Katarina by 50% / 60% / 70% / 80%.

e.name: Shunpo

description.normalized: Blink to a location near a Dagger or unit, dealing 20 / 50 / 80 / 110 (+50% AD +30% AP) magic damage to the nearest enemy. Picking up a Dagger greatly reduces the Cooldown of Shunpo.

r.name: Death Lotus

description.normalized: Rapidly throws blades at the 3 nearest enemy champions, dealing 400 / 600 / 800 (+260% AD +290% AP) magic damage and applying 60% Grievous Wounds. Katarina can move and throw blades for up to 2.6 seconds. Grievous Wounds reduces the effectiveness of Healing and Regeneration effects.
